Title: Can Dagger or Poker be used with Concealed Weapon

Messages.Author: Artemis
Messages.Body:
Concealed Weapon
>
> The weapon cannot cost 3 or more pool or inflict (with a regular strike) aggravated damage or 4 or more damage.
>
Poker
>
> Strength+1 damage each strike. Damage inflicted on a Kiasyd by this weapon is aggravated.
>
with dagger being similar.

Looking through the rulings for concealed weapon  [RTR 19980623] uses the wording
>
> against a generic opponent.
>
but that discussion is concerned with the amount of damage, and not necessarily the type of the damage.

Right now I'm leaning towards yes, but would like a concrete answer.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
You can use Concealed Weapon wih those weapons. They don't deal aggravated damage against a generic opponent.
